name: Slav Defense
description: The true Slav main line: Black meets 2.c4 with 2...c6 and captures 4...dxc4, developing the light-squared bishop to f5 before locking the center with ...e6 — the defining idea of the Slav.

lines.name: Slav Defense — Main Line
lines.description: The main line Slav: 4...dxc4 5.a4 Bf5 — Black develops the c8-bishop outside the pawn chain before playing ...e6, the whole point of the Slav. After 6.e3 e6 7.Bxc4 Bb4, both sides castle into a rich positional struggle.
